description: Nielsen Digital Measurement ads audit pings on audit.imrworldwide.com/cgi-bin/gn. Nielsen documents prd=audit, intid, sessionid, product, and createtm as mandatory. DCR cfg hello pings stay vendor/nielsen.

params.name: prd
params.description: It marks the request as an audit ping. Nielsen documents the ads audit URL as /cgi-bin/gn?prd=audit.
params.fix_hint: Set prd=audit on every ads audit ping.

params.name: intid
params.description: It is the integration ID Nielsen assigns for all audit pings across platforms.
params.fix_hint: Set intid to the integration ID Nielsen issued.

params.name: sessionid
params.description: It is the session ID generated when the player is instantiated. Nielsen documents it as mandatory.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable sessionid for the playback session, and fire again if it changes.

params.name: product
params.description: It names the Nielsen product the ping corresponds to. Nielsen documents examples dar, dcr, and dtvr.
params.fix_hint: Set product to the Nielsen product for this integration, such as dar, dcr, or dtvr.

params.name: createtm
params.description: It is the time the ping was fired. Nielsen documents createtm as Unix time.
params.fix_hint: Set createtm to the Unix timestamp when the ping fired, such as 1643858542.

params.name: apid
params.description: It is the Nielsen Server App ID. Nielsen documents apid as required only for content measurement.
params.fix_hint: Send apid when this audit ping is for content measurement.
